title: "Resurfaced 'KUWTK' Clip Shows Khloe Kardashian Discussing Diddy's 'Butt-Naked' Party"
htmlContent:
Khloé Kardashian's recounting of attending one of Sean 'Diddy' Combs' notorious parties has reignited buzz in a resurfaced clip from the Keeping Up With The Kardashians. The moment, which originally aired in an August 2014 episode titled 'Secrets of a Double Life,' has drawn fresh attention in light of the legal and personal controversies currently surrounding Combs. Khloé and Kourtney Kardashian are seated in the scene, where Khloé is asked about their weekend adventures. Khloé's tight-lipped response is a source of intrigue as Kourtney begins naming celebrities that might have been present.
"Diddy, Quincy [Combs], Justin Bieber, French Montana," Kourtney guesses. Khloé laughs and plays coy, responding, “So far, so good… Do you even know half the people you’re naming?”
The discussion continues later in the episode while Khadijah Haqq and her family friend go bowling. According to Kourtney, Khloé is still hungover from the wild night.
“She didn’t go to bed,” Kourtney teases. In the following scene, Khloé admits, “I got on the plane at 5:30 a.m. Well, this party, I think half the people were butt-naked. You would have loved it.”

Khloé attended Diddy's son's 16th birthday party in West Hollywood in April 2014, around the time the episode aired, even though the party is unclear. Diddy's events were well-known for being over-the-top, attended by A-list celebrities, and filled with mystery due to their outrageous nature.

This nostalgic moment from KUWTK comes amid more serious allegations against Combs. The hip hop mogul is now facing multiple lawsuits, including sexual assault accusations and a federal indictment for racketeering conspiracy and sex trafficking charges. According to the indictment, Combs coerced victims into participating in his notorious parties, which the grand jury alleges involved extreme behavior.

According to court documents, federal agents seized more than 1,000 bottles of baby oil and lubricant. During these events, he used firearms, such as AR-15s with defaced serial numbers, during raids on his Miami and Los Angeles homes earlier this year. As the details continue to unfold, this resurfaced KUWTK clip offers an eerie glimpse into the extravagant and secretive world of Diddy's infamous parties, once the stuff of Hollywood legend, now shadowed by scandal. Khloé's cryptic remarks about the wild night are suddenly taken a step further, leading to more public scrutiny of Combs and his controversial lifestyle.
excerpt: An old Keeping Up With the Kardashians clip has resurfaced, with Khloe Kardashian sharing details about attending one of Diddy’s infamous “butt-naked” parties.
